tree.heading: BIA
tree.text: The term “BIA” means the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

tree.heading: Department
tree.text: The term “Department” means the Department of the Interior.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

tree.heading: Under Secretary
tree.text: The term “Under Secretary” means the Under Secretary for Indian Affairs established under section 5633(a) of this title.
